verdict.rationale: Companies House is a registry service with a REST API and online filing, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers recurring scheduled jobs (for example recurring filings or data pulls). The evidence shows no such feature. 'Follow companies' and 'Get emails' are notification features, not a user-defined recurring schedule, and polling the GET API on a timer would be a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
